problem.title: Finding the right person is still painfully manual.
problem.body: You search across platforms, compare profiles, guess whether someone is relevant, hunt for contact details, and then write outreach from scratch.

how.title: From target description to outreach-ready people.

steps.title: Describe who you want
steps.body: Write a natural-language target instead of building brittle filters.

steps.title: Search public sources
steps.body: SignalReach looks for role fit, company fit, recent signals, evidence, and contactability.

steps.title: Review evidence-backed matches
steps.body: Every result explains why the person fits and which sources support the match.

steps.title: Draft outreach with context
steps.body: Generate messages based on actual evidence, not generic templates.
